explosive_kg.note: a game reference: War Thunder's us_aim7m_sparrow (PBXN-4); no manufacturer or encyclopedia gives the charge

gurney_kms.note: PBXN-4 (DATB-based, insensitive) is not in Cooper's table: as Tritonal (2.32), the lowest listed - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.00438, its base 0.00163, its fins' friction 0.00764 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 0.1078 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.981 for its fineness 17.9 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)
